# BuildAndDo

A daily learning edition built around sources, scoped missions and evidence.

## Public pages

- [BuildAndDo — learn by doing, together](https://buildanddo.tech/): Learn with people and AI, build something real, verify what happened and keep the evidence. A daily learning edition built from the sources you connect.
- [MetaFunction Fabric Platform | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.tech/platform): Explore the governed execution flow, capability mesh and illustrative monitoring of the MetaFunction Fabric.
- [BuildAndDo — Practice library](https://buildanddo.tech/practice): Community-audited methods for real objectives, with evidence, knowledge states and lessons from each attempt.
- [BuildAndDo — Public roadmap](https://buildanddo.tech/roadmap): Follow the BuildAndDo plan, its current state and the evidence needed to call work complete.
- [Pricing & early access | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.tech/pricing): Explore BuildAndDo early access and discuss a team rollout. Public subscription pricing has not been announced.
- [About & team | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.tech/about): Meet the people and principles behind BuildAndDo, a Citadel Nexus Inc. product built around accountable work.
- [Classrooms & shared lessons | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.tech/classrooms): Learn together in workspace classrooms with host-led Field Manual lessons, attendance and saved discussion.
- [Documentation | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.tech/docs): Get started with workspaces, signals, missions, workflows and the evidence ledger. Learn what each state means.
- [The BuildAndDo journal](https://buildanddo.tech/blog): Field notes on learning by doing, bounded work and keeping a traceable record of what you built.
- [Contact | BuildAndDo](https://buildanddo.tech/contact): Ask a product question, report an issue or discuss commercial licensing with Citadel Nexus Inc.
